<div class="card-body">
'''Dejarik Hologameboard''' is a [[Light]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊デジャリック・ホロゲームボード</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここでは“デジャリック・ルール”が適用される。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここでは“デジャリック・ルール”が適用される。この位置カードは「帝国軍ホロテーブル」の上に重ねて置くことができ、効果を変更できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Dejarik-Hologameboard-PSA-135901788.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Dejarik hologameboard.

'''Light Side:'''
Dejarik Rules are in effect here.

'''Dark Side:'''
Dejarik Rules are in effect here. This location card may be stacked on Imperial Holotable and can change its effect.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese Dark lets this card stack on Imperial Holotable and change its effect.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Dejarik Hologameboard]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
